description: This Java source file defines the DeleteService class, an Android IntentService responsible for handling delete requests for calendar event data in a wearable app. It manages GoogleApiClient connections to communicate with Google Play services, performs data item deletions, and shows confirmation animations to the user.

classes.name: DeleteService
classes.description: An IntentService subclass that handles deletion of data items related to calendar events in a wearable app, manages GoogleApiClient lifecycle, and displays confirmation animations based on the success or failure of delete operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks when the service is created.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the data item specified by the intent, manages GoogleApiClient connection state, and shows appropriate confirmation animations.

methods.name: startConfirmationActivity
methods.description: Starts a confirmation activity with specified animation and message to inform the user of success or failure.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback triggered upon successful connection to GoogleApiClient; logs the event.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback for handling suspension of GoogleApiClient connection; logs the cause.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback for handling failure to connect to GoogleApiClient; logs the error.
